It can be seen that city 1 has the highest proportion in the “electronics” industry, at about 45%; at the same time, the proportions of sectors such as machinery, aircraft, automobiles, and steel are relatively balanced, and the proportion of other industries is relatively low. Then infer: Among the four candidate cities, Detroit should be most prominent in the automobile industry, Kolkata commonly has characteristics of traditional industries such as steel and textiles being relatively prominent, Xi'an is more inclined toward industries such as aviation and electronics, while Munich is a German high-tech manufacturing city, with a prominent proportion of the electronics industry and other manufacturing industries also relatively balanced. The structural characteristics of city 1 in the figure match Munich most closely, so city 1 is Munich.

再推理：四个候选城市中，底特律最突出的应是汽车工业，加尔各答常见特征是传统工业如钢铁、纺织较突出，西安则更偏航空、电子等行业；而慕尼黑属于德国高技术制造业城市，电子工业比重突出，其他制造业也较均衡。图中城市1的结构特征与慕尼黑最吻合，因此城市1是慕尼黑。
